statements.status_notes: The Workhorse HSP currently embeds grpc 1.81.0. The patched 1.82.1 release became available after this package build and requires a new HSP revision before the image can consume it.
The Workhorse HSP currently embeds grpc 1.81.0. The patched 1.82.1 release became available after this package build and requires a new HSP revision before the image can consume it.

google.golang.org/grpc 1.81.1 and 1.82.0 are vendored into the reused upstream docker engine stack and buildx apks. Reachability from the shipped binaries is under assessment; remediation requires rebuilding those apks against grpc 1.82.1, which the version tracker will pull in on the next apk bump.
